command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$endpoint="repos/tngkrwlsmd/flyExplorer/actions/permissions/artifact-and-log-retention"
$beforeRaw=(& gh api -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10" $endpoint | Out-String)
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "GitHub CLI cannot read Actions retention setting with current runner auth"}
$before=$beforeRaw | ConvertFrom-Json
Write-Host ("ACTIONS_RETENTION_BEFORE_DAYS="+$before.days)
Write-Host ("ACTIONS_RETENTION_MAXIMUM_ALLOWED_DAYS="+$before.maximum_allowed_days)
if([int]$before.maximum_allowed_days -lt 365){throw "repository/account maximum does not permit 365 days"}
& gh api --method PUT -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10" $endpoint -F days=365
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "failed to set Actions retention to 365 days"}
$afterRaw=(& gh api -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10" $endpoint | Out-String)
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "failed to verify Actions retention after update"}
$after=$afterRaw | ConvertFrom-Json
Write-Host ("ACTIONS_RETENTION_AFTER_DAYS="+$after.days)
Write-Host ("ACTIONS_RETENTION_AFTER_MAXIMUM_ALLOWED_DAYS="+$after.maximum_allowed_days)
if([int]$after.days -ne 365){throw "Actions retention verification did not return 365 days"}
Write-Host "ACTIONS_RETENTION_365=PASS"
